use_cases.name: Withdraw Cash
use_cases.goal: To withdraw a specified amount of cash from the customer's account
preconditions: Customer's ATM card is inserted and recognized
Account balance is greater than or equal to the withdrawal amount
postconditions: Withdrawal amount is deducted from the customer's account balance
Transaction is recorded in the customer's transaction history
Cash is dispensed to the customer

main_flow.action: Enters PIN and selects 'Withdraw Cash' option
Validates the entered PIN against the stored PIN
Enters the desired withdrawal amount
Checks if account balance is sufficient for the requested amount
Deducts the withdrawal amount from the account balance
Records the withdrawal transaction in the transaction history
Dispenses the requested cash amount to the customer
Displays transaction success message to the customer

steps: System prompts customer to re-enter PIN (MF-01 return_to_step)
System increments incorrect PIN attempt counter

alternative_flows.condition: Account balance is insufficient for withdrawal amount
steps: System prompts customer to enter a lower amount (MF-03 return_to_step) or cancel transaction
If customer cancels, system terminates transaction

use_cases.name: Deposit Cash
use_cases.goal: To deposit a specified amount of cash into the customer's account
preconditions: Customer's ATM card is inserted and recognized
postconditions: Deposit amount is added to the customer's account balance
Transaction is recorded in the customer's transaction history

main_flow.action: Enters PIN and selects 'Deposit Cash' option
Validates the entered PIN against the stored PIN
Enters the deposit amount and inserts cash into the cash slot
Verifies the deposit amount is a positive value
Adds the deposit amount to the account balance
Records the deposit transaction in the transaction history
Displays deposit success message and updated balance to the customer

steps: System prompts customer to re-enter PIN (MF-01 return_to_step)
System increments incorrect PIN attempt counter

alternative_flows.condition: Deposit amount is zero or negative
steps: System prompts customer to enter a valid positive amount (MF-03 return_to_step) or cancel transaction

use_cases.name: Check Balance
use_cases.goal: To view the current balance of the customer's account
preconditions: Customer's ATM card is inserted and recognized

main_flow.action: Enters PIN and selects 'Check Balance' option
Validates the entered PIN against the stored PIN
Retrieves the current account balance from the system
Displays the current account balance to the customer

steps: System prompts customer to re-enter PIN (MF-01 return_to_step)
System increments incorrect PIN attempt counter

use_cases.name: Change PIN
use_cases.goal: To update the PIN of the customer's account
preconditions: Customer's ATM card is inserted and recognized
postconditions: Customer's PIN is updated to the new value
PIN change transaction is recorded in the transaction history

main_flow.action: Enters current PIN and selects 'Change PIN' option
Validates the current PIN against the stored PIN
Enters new 4-digit PIN
Re-enters new PIN for confirmation
Verifies new PIN and confirmed PIN match
Updates the stored PIN to the new value
Displays 'PIN Changed Successfully' message to the customer

alternative_flows.condition: Current PIN entered is incorrect (1st/2nd attempt)
steps: System prompts customer to re-enter current PIN (MF-01 return_to_step)
System increments incorrect PIN attempt counter

alternative_flows.condition: Current PIN entered is incorrect (3rd attempt)
New PIN and confirmed PIN do not match
steps: System prompts customer to re-enter new PIN (MF-03 return_to_step)
System prompts customer to enter a 4-digit PIN (MF-03 return_to_step)

use_cases.name: Generate Mini Statement
use_cases.goal: To view a mini statement of recent transactions for the customer's account
preconditions: Customer's ATM card is inserted and recognized
Customer has at least one transaction in history
postconditions: Mini statement (recent 5 transactions) is displayed to the customer

main_flow.action: Enters PIN and selects 'Mini Statement' option
Validates the entered PIN against the stored PIN
Retrieves the most recent 5 transactions from the customer's transaction history
Formats the transactions (type, amount, date/time) into a mini statement
Displays the mini statement to the customer

steps: System prompts customer to re-enter PIN (MF-01 return_to_step)
System increments incorrect PIN attempt counter
System displays 'No Transaction History Found' message
